title: Reflection symmetry of the Gaussian distribution function
statement: Let $\Phi$ be the cumulative distribution function of the standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R$. For every $x\in\mathbb R$, $\Phi(-x)=1-\Phi(x)$.
replaced: The standard Gaussian distribution function satisfies $\Phi(-x)=1-\Phi(x)$ for every real $x$.
